value.rationale: This is a natural sharp language-reconstruction invariant motivated by binomial complexity theory: a whole aperiodic automatic family has binomial order exactly 2 for factor identification, unlike a published sparse linear-gap morphic comparison requiring order 3. The complete arithmetic all-length count adds a reproducible exact invariant, not a tiny arbitrary numerical slice.
